name: Ginseng (species mixed or not stated)
short: Reviews of trials report gastrointestinal symptoms and potential bleeding but no serious adverse events. One small crossover trial found no effect of ginseng on warfarin.
text: An umbrella review of 19 meta-analyses of ginseng (overall of poor methodological quality) reported that adverse events included gastrointestinal symptoms and potential bleeding, but that no serious adverse events were reported. A meta-analysis of 19 randomised trials of ginseng and ginseng herbal formulas for fatigue found that ginseng did not increase adverse events compared with controls. On interactions, an open-label randomised crossover study in 12 healthy men (the abstract does not state the ginseng species) found that taking ginseng with a single dose of warfarin did not affect warfarin's blood levels, INR or platelet aggregation.
